description: All EPC certificates lodged for a property over time, with floor area, room counts and rating per certificate. A floor-area jump between certificates with no matching planning record is the single highest-value red flag for a cash buyer.

property_id.description: The property id returned by search_property (an EPC certificate lmk-key). Prefer this over re-supplying a postcode once you have it.
